book.name: iJɔn
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iJɔn

content: IYesu byi inggisɛ idubu eda enbwa
Ngwi ungwɔnɛ wa nyɛ nɛ, iYesu fooye lu byulu mi agya Ekyoo Okwukwo mgbi iGalalia (ngwi a di li kwun di ekyoo iTiberia kpaa nani),
nɛ ibyi inggisɛ kpakpa kyɛdɔn ikyekyɛ a di ambɛ okwulewo ngwi o kyɔ mbi emi ootse mani.
Man iYesu tɔ lu unggwɔ ka sisɛ yi emi ongwafɔɔn.
Oga owɛ owatɔ-watɔ mgbi emi iJuda dzɛ kwɛkwɛ mi onɔ mani.
Ngwi iYesu kyile inɛ esho di ibyi inggisɛ kpakpa kyɛ le ba mbi ongwu nɛ, o si byi iFyilipi gbɛɛ, <<Li mi ole ngwi eyi ka gya ibredi nu inggisɛ ntonɛ gye?>>
IYesu byita nɛ ikye ombadun ta, ikyesinɛ o teyi ye mi itukwu mgban ungwɔ ngwi ongwu ka kyɔ.
IFyilipi nun uka gbɛɛ, <<Udza okpa idɔ mgbi ofyia egyata kpaa ka mɛ ogya ibredi nu ma tsan aba kpatsɛ ba!>>
Ongwafɔ mgbi iYesu oka, Andru, ongwunɔ iSaimɔn iPyita si gbɛɛ,
<<Ongwongyulɔ dzɛ mmɛnɛni ngwu dzɛ yi ibredi ngwi a kyɔ mi ibale nghi eda bɛyi ongwɛ abatsa efa, ntonɛ ka to ole mbi ibyi inggisɛ ntonɛ?>>
IYesu si gbɛɛ, <<Ni inggisɛ ntonɛ sisɛ.>> Oshɛ kyinda mi imbe na kpakpa man inggisɛ ntona sisɛ mi ele, engyulɔ mɛ dafi idubu eda sini.
IYesu si kyelu ibredi kye angba nu Imgbasho man kye nu engwafɔ mgban nu ma kye gha inggisɛ ntonani, o di kyɔ ngha yi mmbweni yɛyɛ, ama duu gye dafi a mina mani.
Ngwi inggisɛ duu tu gye gyɔlo ma nɛ, o si nya engwafɔɔn gbɛɛ, <<Kyi salu ambulu nsisi ma kwakye mbonyi ni unkonyi ka nyanya ba na.>>
A si kye salu ambulu ibredi ibale nghi eda ngwi a gye sisi ma mbwo uya nghi iwyodefa.
Dafi inggisɛ ntona di ambɛ okwulewo ngwi iYesu kyɔ nɛ, a gbɛɛ, <<Mi otsitsi yɔ, nɛnɛ li oyegbɔ nwogyɔ gbɛɛ o ka ba ɛsɛ mani.>>
Ngwi iYesu di gbɛɛ, a wewo ogye ongwu utɔ mi abumfye nɛ, o wulɛ lu unggwɔ ka dzɛ yuon.
IYesu kyikyɛ mi ikye eni
Mi onɔdɛ nani, engwafɔɔn kɛ utɔ,
a kaka uwaa le fooye lu iKapenahun dafi imbe yifu wa, kpaa iYesu ba wa tu ma waba.
Awo wa le fa fyumfye, dile gbe akpeni.
Dafi a fa uwaa kɛ mɛ imai eta naadi eta dɔ itsitsi nɛ, a di iYesu kyikyɛ mi ikye eni le ba kwɛkwɛ yi ama, ta imio wo ma.
Nghaduu o nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Li Ani, ka mio ba na.>>
Nɛ a mina okyon kaka uwaa, ntunto nɛta uwaa to ondu esɛ mi imbe ngwi a le kɛ mani.
Tegblifan ibyi inggisɛ ama nto oye utɔ agya oka nɛ difwi gbɛɛ li uwaa onyi ta bɛdzɛ mmana edɛdɛ ma iYesu edɛdɛ kaka yi engwafɔɔn ba, a lu yuoma.
Nɛ uwaa angbeka kyɛ iTiberia wa bɛsɛ kwɛkwɛ yi imbe ngwi inggisɛ ntona gye ibredi mi onɔ ngwi Otsɛ iYesu nose kye angba nu Imgbasho nani.
Ngwi ibyi inggisɛ ntona di gbɛɛ, iYesu naadi engwafɔ mgban to mmana wuba nɛ, a kaka uwaa ntona lu oyombo iKapenahun oka pitan.
IYesu ungwogye mgbi oshishe
Ngwi a tun mi oyombo utɔ nɛ, a byun gbɛɛ, <<Otsetse, li alonɔ ngwi abu to mmɛnɛ?>>
IYesu nu ma uka gbɛɛ, <<N nya ema otsitsi, ema le pita ani ikyegbɛɛ di ema di ambɛ okwulewo ba, kpaa li ikyegbɛɛ ema gye ungwogye kpakpa tolo.
Ka kyidɔ mi ikye ungwogye nli mbe ba, kpaa mi ikye ungwogye nka dzɛ ba oshishe igyegwu ngwi Ongwɛ Inggisɛ ka kye nu ema mani, ikyesinɛ Imgbasho Otsɔn teyi kye ambɛ mgbi ogbela ungwɔ nun.>>
Nɛ a byi iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Li alungwɔ ngwi eyi ka kyɔ kyɛmɛ ikye okyidɔ ama ngwi Imgbasho mina?>>
IYesu si nu uka gbɛɛ, <<Idɔ mgbi Imgbasho ma li ongwu aani: li onoyɛyɛ mbi ongwu Imgbasho dɔn esɔ nɛni.>>
Nghanɛ a byun gbɛɛ, <<Li ali ambɛ okwulewo ngwi abu ka kyɔ ikye ni eyi diyɛ nu abu oyɛyɛ? Li alungwɔ ngwi abu ka kyɔ?
Emi otsikyeyi nose gye imana nkyɛ esho kyɛ, mi okwɛsɛ dafi ngwi a tsekise lɔ gbɛɛ: <O kye ungwogye kyɛ esho nu ma gye mani.> >>
IYesu nya ma gbɛɛ, <<N nya ema otsitsi, li iMose kye ungwogye nkyɛ esho na nu ema ba, kpaa li Otsani kye ungwogye otsitsi nkyɛ esho na nu ema.
Ikyekyɛ ungwogye mgbi Imgbasho li ongwu nkyɛ esho ba esɛ wa kye oshishe nu ɛsɛ nɛni.>>
A gbɛɛ, <<Ongyukwo, le nu eyi ungwogye na alegbe-alegbe.>>
Nɛ iYesu nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Li ani li ungwogye mgbi oshishe, inggisɛ nba mbi ani yɔ enbwa ka dɔn wuba, inggisɛ ndi nu ani oyɛyɛ yɔ ekweni ka kwun wuba.
Kpaa dafi Ani nya ema ma, ema di ani wa, nghaduu ema noyɛyɛ ba.
Ama ngwu Otsani kye ma nu ani duu a ka ba mbi ani, ali inggisɛ ndi ba mbi Ani duu n ka lɔn onya ba.
Ikyena Ani kyɛ esho ba esɛ owa kyɔ owitukwu mgbi ani ba, kpaa okyɔ owitukwu mgbi ongwu ndɔ ani esɔ mani.
Ma nɛnɛ li owitukwu mgbi ongwu ndɔ ani esɔ ma aani: gbɛɛ ama ngwu ongwu gbe nu ani duu onyi kpaa no ka byulu mi ele ba, kpaa ni Ani kyile ma esho mi egbe ongwi olɛlɛ.
Lubana owitukwu mgbi Otsani li ogbɛɛ, ali inggisɛ ndi Ongwɛ di nun oyɛyɛ ka tu oshishe gyegwu, Ani dika kyilen mi ikwu mi egbe ongwi olɛlɛ mani.>>
Mi ungwɔnɛ emi iJuda wita ondandu mi ikye odzɛ mgbi iYesu ikyekyɛ o gbɛɛ, <<Ani li ungwogye nkyɛ esho ba esɛ.>>
A gbɛɛ, <<Nɛnɛ li iYesu lo, ongwɛ iJose, ongwu eyi ye otsɔn yi onɔn nɛ baa? Kyɔsinɛ ngwi o ka gbɔ onɛnɛ gbɛɛ, Ani kyɛ esho ba esɛ?>>
IYesu nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Nya ondandu yi ewema na.>>
<<Inggisɛ onyi kpaa ka ba mbi ani ba se Otsani ndɔ ani esɔ ma kwon ba mbi ani, ani dika kyilen mi ikwu mi egbe ongwi olɛlɛ mani.
A teyi lɔ mi afɛ mgbi ama ogbɛɛsɛ gbɛɛ: <Imgbasho ka tso ma tsatsa.> Ali inggisɛ ngaadɔ mbi Otsani di kpayi mbon yɔ ka ba mbi ani.
Inggisɛ onyi kpaa di Otsani ye ba, li ongwu nkyɛ mbi Imgbasho nɛ ta, li ongwu yuon di Otsɔn aali.
N nya ema otsitsi, inggisɛ nnoyɛyɛ dzɛ yi oshishe gyegwu.
Ani li ungwogye mgbi oshishe.
Emi otsikyema gye imana mi imbe okplagada ungwogye nkye esho ba esɛ nani, nghaduu kpaa a kwulu.
Kpaa ungwogye nkyɛ esho ba esɛ dzɛ mmɛnɛni, ngwi inggisɛ ka gye di kwulu wuba.
Ani li ungwogye mgbi oshishe nkyɛ esho ba esɛ. Inggisɛ ta ngye ungwogye nɛ o ka dzɛ oshishe gyegwu, ungwogye nɛ li ikpewo mgbi ani ongwu ani ka kye nu mi ikye oshishe mgbi ɛsɛ.>>
Nɛ emi iJuda ntona wita otangwɛ yi ewoma mi itɔdzɛ ngwi iYesu gbɔ nani, gbɛɛ, <<Kyɔsinɛ ngwi inggisɛ nɛ ka kye ikpewo mgban nu eyi gye?>>
IYesu nya ma gbɛɛ, <<N nya ema otsitsi se ni ema gye ikpewo mgbi Ongwɛ Inggisɛ di wa eyi mgban bayɔ, ema dzɛ yi oshishe mbi ema ba.
Ali inggisɛ ngye ikpewo mgbi ani diyɛ wa eyi mgbi ani dzɛ yi oshishe igyegwu, ani dika kyilen mi ikwu mi egbe ongwi olɛlɛ.
Ikyesinɛ, ikpewo mgbi ani li ungwogye otsitsi, eyi mgbi ani di li ungwɔ owawa otsitsi.
Inggisɛ ta ngye ikpewo mgbi ani di wa eyi mgbi ani wodzɛ mbi ani, ani kpaa wodzɛ mbon.
Yɛyɛ dafi Otsani ndzɛ oshishe dɔ ani esɔ mani, ani di dzɛ oshishe li ikye Otsani nani, nghanɛ inggisɛ ngye di wa mbi ani yɔ, ka dzɛ oshishe ikye ani.
Nɛnɛ li ungwogye nkyɛ esho ba esɛ mani, emi otsikyema gye imana nghaduu a kwulu, kpaa inggisɛ nbyi ewon enbwa yi ungwogye ngwi ani kye nu nɛ, ka dzɛ oshishe gyegwu.>>
IYesu gbɔdzɛ nɛ mi onɔ ngwi o le tsungwɔ mi ozu okwakye mgbi emi iJuda mi iKapenahun mani.
Engwafɔ mgbi iYesu kwuba dzatan
Ngwi a fwo odzɛ nɛ nghanɛ, engwafɔ mgbi iYesu kwuba gbɛɛ, <<Otsootso nɛ fyumfye, li emɛ ka gbelan?>>
IYesu ye dafi engwafɔɔn tole ndandu mi odzɛ nɛni, o si byi ma gbɛɛ, <<Odzɛ nɛ nu ema ka dzani taa?
Kini ema di Ongwɛ Inggisɛ yɛ lu esho mi imbe ngwi o teyi dzɛ ma ema ka gbɔsinɛ?
Onodzi mgbi Imgbasho li nu oshishe; mfye mgbi inggisɛ owamyɛ dzɛ yi oyabɔ ba duudu. Elodzɛ ngwi ani gbɔ nya ema ntonɛ li onodzi, a di li oshishe kpaa.
Nghaduu ema angbeka to ma ngwu noyɛyɛ ba.>> Ikyesinɛ iYesu teyi ye mi owita-wita ama ngwu noyɛyɛ ba mi idzidzɛ ema, yi ongwu nka wa kyen gya mani.
O kiyayi gbɛɛ, <<Li ungwɔ ngwi ani nya ema gbɛɛ inggisɛ onyi kpaa ka ba mbi ani ba se Otsani nun ofɛ ma aani.>>
Wita mi onɔ na emi ongwafɔɔn kwuba kyata iyikpa di kyɛdɔn wuba.
Nghanɛ iYesu byi engwafɔ mgban iwyodefa ntona gbɛɛ, <<Ema kpaa i mina ema odzata anii?>>
ISaimɔn iPyita nu uka gbɛɛ, <<Otsɛ li mbi emɛ eyi ka kɛ? Abu dzɛ yi elodzɛ mgbi oshishe ogyegwu.
Eyi noyɛyɛ di ye gbɛɛ abu li iKrestu, ongwɛ Imgbasho oshishe.>>
Nɛ iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Ani sadu ema nghi iwyodefa baa? Nghaduu onyi mbi ema li olodu!>>
(O gbɔdzɛ mgbi iJuda ongwɛ Iskarɔti, ikyesinɛ ngwi o li onyi mbi engwafɔɔn nɛ kpaa, o ka wa kye ongwu gya.)
